item.text: {"summary":"An annual wild pea native to Europe, North Africa and much of Asia, hairy vetchling has winged stems and paired leaflets ending in coiled, branching tendrils. Its pink, blue or two-coloured flowers are followed by hairy pods, while the rest of the plant is generally hairless.","humanEdibility":"unknown","edibilityNote":null,"evidence":{"summary":["s1:p2"],"humanEdibility":[]}}
